question: Which of the following processes is NOT a point mutation in the DNA sequence ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Translocation -> involves the movement of a segment of DNA to another chromosome -> not a point mutation -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Insertion -> involves the addition of extra nucleotides into the DNA sequence -> a type of point mutation -> not the correct answer -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Deletion -> involves the removal of nucleotides from the DNA sequence -> a type of point mutation -> not the correct answer -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Substitution -> involves the replacement of one nucleotide with another -> a type of point mutation -> not the correct answer -> 95%
analysis: Point mutations involve changes in a single nucleotide base in the DNA sequence. Translocation is a type of chromosomal mutation where a segment of one chromosome breaks off and attaches to another chromosome, not involving a single nucleotide base change.
